name: Nagisa Grill
description: Nagisa Grill is an editorial magazine WordPress theme designed for coastal seafood restaurants and daily-catch kitchens. Built around a calm day-schedule layout with serif typography and full-bleed imagery, it reflects the unhurried rhythm of one boat and one dinner service. Lightweight and block-first, it offers dedicated patterns for daily service times, kitchen notes, and table reservations without requiring extra plugins.
